categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the biopharmaceutical sector, focusing on the research, development, production, and commercialization of innovative biologic drugs and vaccines. Key therapeutic areas include malignant tumors, autoimmune diseases, infectious diseases, and genetic disorders. The company has developed a diversified product portfolio including recombinant proteins, monoclonal antibodies, biosimilars, and innovative vaccines.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced biopharmaceutical technologies including recombinant protein expression in CHO and insect cells, monoclonal and bispecific antibody engineering, virus-like particle (VLP) vaccine technology, and novel adjuvant development. It has proprietary platforms for antibody discovery, production process optimization, quality control, and large-scale manufacturing under GMP and international standards. The company emphasizes technology innovation to improve yield, product stability, and cost efficiency, including domestic sourcing of raw materials to reduce supply chain risks.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's primary customers are healthcare institutions such as hospitals and pharmacies within China, with expanding presence in Belt and Road developing countries including Pakistan, Indonesia, Thailand, and the Philippines. The products target patients suffering from hemophilia, various cancers, autoimmune diseases, and infectious diseases. The company also targets international markets including the US and Australia for clinical trials and future commercialization.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with headquarters and production facilities in Beijing and surrounding areas. It has established international subsidiaries and is actively expanding into developing countries along the Belt and Road initiative. Clinical trials and regulatory filings are underway in developed markets such as the United States and Australia, indicating a strategic push for global presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the biopharmaceutical supply chain, encompassing drug discovery, clinical development, manufacturing, and commercialization. It controls its own production facilities and quality systems, and manages procurement of raw materials and consumables, with efforts to increase domestic sourcing. The company also engages in sales and distribution through self-operated teams and third-party agents.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation-driven growth with significant R&D investment focused on developing 'best-in-class' and 'me-better' biologics. Key R&D directions include monoclonal and multispecific antibodies, recombinant protein vaccines (notably a 14-valent HPV vaccine), and novel immunotherapies targeting oncology and autoimmune diseases. The company is enhancing digital project management systems to improve R&D efficiency and accelerating clinical trials domestically and internationally.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of biologics and vaccines to hospitals, pharmacies, and distributors. The company employs a direct sales model supported by a nationwide sales force and CSO agents, supplemented by partnerships with major pharmaceutical distributors. Revenue streams also include government reimbursements via national and provincial medical insurance programs.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in the highly competitive biopharmaceutical industry against both domestic and international firms specializing in biologics and biosimilars. It positions itself as a leading innovator in China with proprietary technology platforms and a growing product portfolio. Its competitive advantages include high production capacity, cost-effective manufacturing, and early entry into underserved therapeutic areas such as hemophilia and head and neck cancers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved total revenue of approximately RMB 2.51 billion, representing a 33.13% year-over-year increase, and returned to profitability with a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 111.95 million. The company’s total assets grew by 20.8% to RMB 3.28 billion. R&D expenses remain substantial, accounting for 37.25% of revenue, reflecting a strong commitment to innovation. The company has improved its equity position through perpetual bond financing and operational efficiencies.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes delivering high-quality, innovative biologics and vaccines with differentiated clinical benefits and cost advantages. Its flagship product, a recombinant coagulation factor VIII (Anjia Yin®), is the first domestically produced drug of its kind in China with high production capacity and no albumin additives. The company’s immunotherapies and vaccines target unmet medical needs with superior efficacy and safety profiles, supported by robust clinical data and inclusion in national insurance formularies, enhancing patient access and affordability.
